chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: His marriage to Beatrice and their later marriage in 1956
summary: He married a woman named Beatrice, divorced about 1955, and married Margaret in New Haven in 1956.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Did you ever read anything about him after that?
Yes, I read about him now and then. He got married.
He married a woman named Beatrice.
How long did they stay married?
You say he married a lady named Beatrice. When did he get a divorce?
That must have been around '55... He and I got married in '56.
You came up, obviously, to New York. Was he still in contact with you in West Virginia?
